d: How old is Diwali? And did it always mean the same thing to everyone? The festival we celebrate today has a fascinating history. From Lord Ram's return to Ayodhya and the defeat of Narakasura to Kali Puja, Mahavira's nirvana and Bandi Chhor Divas - different communities celebrate different stories under the same festival. So, how did these traditions come together? And what makes Diwali one of India's most diverse celebrations? Palki Sharma tells you.
